snippet.title: Lightspeed Lina - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
The Kickstarter trailer for "Lightspeed Lina", which is planned to release for Windows PCs on Steam.

--

Support us on Kickstarter!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cornflowerblue/lightspeed-lina

Wishlist the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982870/

--

"Lightspeed Lina" is a momentum-based 3D platformer where you blaze through a chain of nonlinear colorful islands; collecting items, outfits, and new powers that allow you to explore further and unlock more of their secrets.
